{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.06

|gr1= Camera Control
|gr2= Turrets

|descr= Enables / disables direction stabilization of turrets. This command only has an effect if the current optic mode of the selected turret has {{hl|directionStabilized}} configured in config.

|s1= vehicle [[enableDirectionStabilization]] [enabled, turretPath]

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]]

|p2= enabled: [[Boolean]] - enable or disable turret stabilization

|p3= turretPath: [[Turret Path]] - (Optional)

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>uav enableDirectionStabilization [false, [0]]; // Disable direction stabilization for the first turret</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>uav enableDirectionStabilization [true, [0]];</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>uav enableDirectionStabilization [false]; // Disable direction stabilization for the primary turret</sqf>

|seealso= [[directionStabilizationEnabled]] [[lockCameraTo]] [[enableGunStabilization]]
}}
